title: LM and Client Management
summary: This module provides the foundational interfaces and utilities for managing Language Models (LMs) and their clients within DSPy. It includes the abstract `BaseLM` class, mechanisms for caching LLM calls, logging LiteLLM interactions, and concrete implementations for various LM providers and embedding services.

nodes.label: Define Base LM Interface
nodes.title: Base Language Model Interface
nodes.description: Provides the abstract interface (BaseLM) for all language models in DSPy, defining common methods for text generation, history management, and response processing. All concrete LM implementations inherit from this.

nodes.label: Manage LM Call Caching
nodes.title: Language Model Call Caching
nodes.description: Implements flexible caching mechanisms (disk and memory) for LM calls. It intercepts requests, stores responses, and retrieves cached results to optimize performance and reduce redundant API calls.

nodes.label: Wrap LiteLLM API Calls
nodes.title: LiteLLM API Wrapper
nodes.description: Handles direct synchronous and asynchronous interactions with the LiteLLM library for text completion, chat completion, and embedding generation. It includes retry logic and integrates with the caching system.

nodes.label: Implement Specific LM Clients
nodes.title: Specific LM Provider Clients
nodes.description: Provides concrete implementations for interacting with various language model platforms, such as Databricks, local SGLang servers, and OpenAI, adhering to the BaseLM interface.

nodes.label: Track LM Finetuning Jobs
nodes.title: LM Finetuning Job Tracker
nodes.description: Manages and monitors the lifecycle of finetuning jobs on specific platforms (e.g., Databricks, OpenAI). It allows for tracking progress, status checks, and potentially cancellation of jobs.

nodes.label: DSPy Program
nodes.title: DSPy Program/Module
nodes.description: Represents a DSPy program or module that leverages language models for various tasks, interacting with the LM management system to perform predictions.

nodes.label: DSPy Global Configuration
nodes.title: DSPy Global Settings
nodes.description: Manages global configuration settings for DSPy, including caching behavior, LiteLLM logging levels, and other operational parameters that influence LM interactions.

nodes.label: External LM Services
nodes.title: External Language Model Providers
nodes.description: Represents the actual external APIs and services provided by various language model vendors (e.g., OpenAI, Databricks, Hugging Face) that DSPy clients interact with.

nodes.label: External Embedding Services
nodes.title: External Embedding Providers
nodes.description: Represents external services responsible for generating vector embeddings from text inputs, which are utilized by DSPy's embedding generation functionalities.

groups.label: LM Abstraction Core
groups.title: Language Model Abstraction Core
groups.description: Defines the fundamental abstract interface for all language models within DSPy, ensuring a consistent way to interact with diverse LLM providers.

groups.label: Client Operations
groups.title: LM Client Operations & Caching
groups.description: Manages the core operational aspects of interacting with language models, including efficient caching of responses and direct API calls via the LiteLLM wrapper.

groups.label: Provider Integrations
groups.title: Specific LM Provider Integrations
groups.description: Handles concrete implementations for various external language model providers and provides mechanisms for tracking finetuning jobs on these platforms.

groups.label: System Context & External
groups.title: System Context and External Services
groups.description: Encompasses the broader DSPy program context, global configurations, and the external language model and embedding services that this module interacts with.
